purpose: Authored archive for the ITT revision. Heavy preparation runs in GitHub Actions. No generated historical people or fake documents.
limitations: No reusable licensed Chile 1970 election or 1973 ITT hearing motion footage was secured. Bell System footage is identified only as American telephone-industry context; historical Chile passages use authentic photographs and original documents.
No verified reusable Harold Geneen or William Broe portrait was secured. Their actions are shown through genuine documentary records and labeled explanatory diagrams, without invented faces.
